Author: OmegaJackie
Name: Relicable
Changelog:
1.5.5.8 - everything since 1.5.4.5. Mostly getting unstuck:

Getting stuck: an aggro watchdog now runs for EVERY step rather than only the fighting ones, so a mob that lands on you while travelling, waiting or staging gets fought back instead of ignored - and 'aggroed' is read from the enmity table rather than from where a mob happens to be looking. Standing on the spot against an enemy you have no line to (usually one above or below you) now re-paths to a spot that actually has the shot, and gives up on it after fifteen seconds instead of shuffling for ever. Escort leves walk in long legs instead of stop-starting every few yalms. Leve objective points that sit under the floor are lifted onto it, which used to strand the run jittering underground.

Teleporting: the step now stands still while it casts (movement cancels it, and nothing was stopping the character), asks the game whether Teleport can be used before firing it rather than firing blind, waits out combat instead of failing, and retries in seconds rather than three quarters of a minute. Failures say what it would have cost and what you are carrying.

Dying: death recovery no longer mistakes the Return teleport for the resurrection - it used to decide you were alive 97 milliseconds after pressing Return, resume, find itself still dead, and loop. It also says why it is stuck instead of retrying silently. And in a FATE that is going badly, it now drops level sync below 10% health and lives, rather than dying for one FATE's credit - unless the enemy is going to die first.

Books: finishing your ninth book now goes to Jalzahn for the enhancement instead of buying book 1 again for 500 poetics and regrinding all nine. New /relic booksdone tells it the books are finished when it has no record of its own.

Also: optional auto-discard of mob drops so a long unattended run stops filling its bags (off by default, Configuration - Inventory, with a live list of exactly what would go), and a book FATE you cleared yourself is no longer written off as someone else's.
Punchline: Automate the ARR Zodiac relic line
Description:
Data-driven automation engine for the ARR Zodiac relic line (A Relic Reborn through Zodiac Zeta). It plans and drives the stage objectives - Atma FATE farming, Animus book leves and dungeons, Novus materia/scroll planning, Nexus light farming, and the Jalzahn/Gerolt upgrade turn-ins - by orchestrating other plugins over IPC rather than replacing them.

Requires these companion plugins, installed and working: vnavmesh (movement), BossMod Reborn, Rotation Solver Reborn or Wrath Combo (combat), Lifestream (aetheryte travel), TextAdvance (dialogue), and AutoDuty (dungeons). The Dependencies tab in /relic config shows live status for each.

USE AT YOUR OWN RISK: automating movement and combat is botting under the FINAL FANTASY XIV User Agreement, and Square Enix suspends and terminates accounts for it. The risk is highest for the open-world stages (Atma, Animus, Nexus, Zeta), which run in shared content where other players can observe and report you. Neither this plugin nor its authors can reduce that risk or protect you from it.

This software takes control of your character for long unattended sessions. It is incomplete, it has rough edges, and stages will occasionally stall and need manual help. Do not run it unattended if that is not acceptable to you. Bug reports should include /xllog output with 'Enable debug log' turned on in /relic config.
